name: What is the process for getting custom built-in shelving installed?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting custom built-in shelving installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your needs, preferences, and the space where the shelving will be installed. This includes taking preliminary measurements and understanding your style. Next, we develop design concepts and provide detailed renderings or sketches along with a material selection and cost estimate. Once approved, materials are ordered, and fabrication begins, either on-site or in our workshop. The installation phase involves careful assembly, securing the units, and finishing work like painting or staining. Finally, a thorough cleanup and final inspection are conducted to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design and estimate, material selection, fabrication, installation, and final finishing, concluding with an inspection.
